main.description: A project — a container a creator groups related works and posts under. It deliberately carries NO list of what is in it: a record naming its own contents has to be rewritten every time a work is added or removed, which broadcasts a new version on every change and makes the record a worse copy of a query. Membership belongs on the other end, as an optional field on the work, which may be added later at no cost.

title.description: The project's name, as its creator wrote it. Plain text, for the same reason every other name in these schemas is: a consumer should be able to render it without a sanitizer.

url.description: Where the project can be reached. Not assumed to be an anthers.org address, because a creator hosting their own catalog points at their own.

description.description: The creator's own summary of what the project is. Plain text, so that every consumer can render it safely without a sanitizer.
